project.title: AI-Powered AR Mobile Cosmetics & Beauty Try-On App
project.shortDescription: A cutting-edge AR application enabling real-time cosmetic try-ons, AI hair/skin analysis, and product matching.
project.description: Developed as a Final Year Project, this AI-powered augmented reality beauty application enables users to virtually try cosmetic products in real time. Implemented live makeup rendering using native GPU rendering and Flutter UI. Integrated AI-based Makeup and hair colour try-on, hairstyle matcher, and skin/hair analysis features using trained TFLite models. Added e-commerce integration, product comparison tools, admin & delivery portals. Integrated Gemini API and OpenRouter APIs for AI-powered recommendations and assistance.
features: Real-time makeup rendering using native GPU shader code.
TFLite models for real-time hair coloring, skin analysis, and hairstyle mapping.
Gemini API & OpenRouter integration for personalized AI beauty advice.
Complete e-commerce shop with comparing features, delivery tracking, and administrative portal.
project.challenge: Minimizing inference latency of ML models on lower-end mobile devices while rendering high-quality makeup shaders at 60fps.
project.solution: Quantized and optimized 8 TensorFlow Lite models to run under 150ms inference latency, and implemented custom mobile shaders to reduce CPU overhead.
